blocks.title: Spyware
blocks.text: Spyware is harmful software that secretly watches what you do on your computer or phone.
A free app from an unreliable source may install spyware that secretly records the websites you visit and the information you type.

blocks.prompt: Which harmful software secretly monitors your computer or phone (MCQ 3)?

items: Spyware: hidden software that spies on your activity; avoid apps from unreliable sources.
